# Knowledge.Deck

> > A ChatGPT-powered knowledge categorization experiment exploring human knowledge across linguistics, technology, and environmental topics.

Knowledge.Deck is an automated knowledge base that uses AI to generate and organize articles across diverse domains. The site demonstrates how generative AI can systematically categorize and present information on topics ranging from linguistic theory to sustainable development.

## Key Topics

- ChatGPT
- Knowledge categorization
- AI-generated content
- Generative Grammar
- Syntax and linguistics
- Information Technology
- Software Development
- Sustainable Development
- Grammar theory
- Transformational Grammar
- Chomskyan linguistics
- Phrase Structure Rules
- Cybersecurity
- Cloud computing
- Renewable energy

## About & Core Information

- [Knowledge.Deck](https://knowledge.deck.no/about): About page explaining ChatGPT-powered knowledge categorization experiment

## Science & Technology

- [Information Technology](https://knowledge.deck.no/science-and-technology/information-technology): IT fundamentals covering software, cybersecurity, and cloud computing

## Languages & Linguistics

- [Syntax](https://knowledge.deck.no/languages-and-linguistics/syntax): Linguistics guide on sentence structure and grammar theories

## Environment & Sustainability

- [Sustainable Development](https://knowledge.deck.no/environment-and-ecology/sustainable-development): Guide on renewable energy, eco-practices, and climate mitigation
